    SELECT sc.zoneref, AVG(sp.pointdense) as avg_density
    FROM scans sc
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON sc.arcref = sp.arcref AND sc.crewref = sp.crewref

args.sql:
-- Check PCDR calculation for a sample site
WITH scan_data AS (
    SELECT sc.zoneref, sp.totalpts, sp.clouddense, ss.aream2
    FROM scans sc
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON sc.arcref = sp.arcref AND sc.crewref = sp.crewref
    JOIN scanspatial ss ON sc.arcref = ss.arcref AND sc.crewref = ss.crewref
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT *, 
       totalpts::numeric / (clouddense * aream2) as pcdr
FROM scan_data;

-- Check scanfeatures data alongside pointcloud data for same sites
SELECT 
    sf.zoneref,
    sf.traitcount,
    sf.articount,
    sp.clouddense,
    sp.totalpts,
    ss.aream2,
    sp.totalpts::numeric / (sp.clouddense * ss.aream2) as pcdr,
    (sf.traitcount + sf.articount) as feature_sum,
    sqrt(sp.clouddense) as sqrt_clouddense
FROM scanfeatures sf
JOIN scans sc ON sf.zoneref = sc.zoneref
JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON sc.arcref = sp.arcref AND sc.crewref = sp.crewref
JOIN scanspatial ss ON sc.arcref = ss.arcref AND sc.crewref = ss.crewref
LIMIT 10;

-- Try FEE = (traitcount + articount) * sqrt(clouddense) / PCDR
WITH scan_data AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.zoneref,
        sp.totalpts,
        sp.clouddense,
        ss.aream2,
        sf.traitcount,
        sf.articount,
        sp.totalpts::numeric / (sp.clouddense * ss.aream2) as pcdr
    FROM scans sc
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON sc.arcref = sp.arcref AND sc.crewref = sp.crewref
    JOIN scanspatial ss ON sc.arcref = ss.arcref AND sc.crewref = ss.crewref
    JOIN scanfeatures sf ON sc.zoneref = sf.zoneref
)
SELECT zoneref, pcdr, 
       (traitcount + articount) * sqrt(clouddense) / pcdr as fee
FROM scan_data LIMIT 10;

-- Build full query with CTEs for separate aggregations
WITH pcdr_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.zoneref,
        AVG(sp.totalpts::numeric / (sp.clouddense * ss.aream2)) as avg_pcdr
    FROM scans sc
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON sc.arcref = sp.arcref AND sc.crewref = sp.crewref
    JOIN scanspatial ss ON sc.arcref = ss.arcref AND sc.crewref = ss.crewref
    GROUP BY sc.zoneref
),
fee_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        sf.zoneref,
        AVG((sf.traitcount + sf.articount) * sqrt(sp.clouddense) / (sp.totalpts::numeric / (sp.clouddense * ss.aream2))) as avg_fee
    FROM scanfeatures sf
    JOIN scans sc ON sf.zoneref = sc.zoneref
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON sc.arcref = sp.arcref AND sc.crewref = sp.crewref
    JOIN scanspatial ss ON sc.arcref = ss.arcref AND sc.crewref = ss.crewref
    GROUP BY sf.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    p.avg_pcdr AS density_ratio,
    f.avg_fee AS extraction_efficiency
FROM sites s
JOIN pcdr_calc p ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref
JOIN fee_calc f ON s.zoneregistry = f.zoneref
ORDER BY s.zoneregistry;

-- Try aggregating traits first, then computing FEE
WITH site_traits AS (
    SELECT zoneref, 
           SUM(traitcount) as total_traits,
           SUM(articount) as total_artifacts
    FROM scanfeatures
    GROUP BY zoneref
),
site_pointcloud AS (
    SELECT sc.zoneref,
           SUM(sp.totalpts) as total_pts,
           AVG(sp.clouddense) as avg_clouddense,
           ss.aream2
    FROM scans sc
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON sc.arcref = sp.arcref AND sc.crewref = sp.crewref
    JOIN scanspatial ss ON sc.arcref = ss.arcref AND sc.crewref = ss.crewref
    GROUP BY sc.zoneref, ss.aream2
)
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    sp.total_pts::numeric / (sp.avg_clouddense * sp.aream2) as density_ratio,
    (st.total_traits + st.total_artifacts) * sqrt(sp.avg_clouddense) / (sp.total_pts::numeric / (sp.avg_clouddense * sp.aream2)) as extraction_efficiency
FROM sites s
JOIN site_pointcloud sp ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref
JOIN site_traits st ON s.zoneregistry = st.zoneref
ORDER BY s.zoneregistry
LIMIT 10;

-- Compute PCDR and FEE per record, then average by site
WITH record_data AS (
    SELECT 
        sf.zoneref,
        sp.totalpts::numeric / (sp.clouddense * ss.aream2) as pcdr,
        (sf.traitcount + sf.articount) * sqrt(sp.clouddense) / (sp.totalpts::numeric / (sp.clouddense * ss.aream2)) as fee
    FROM scanfeatures sf
    JOIN scans sc ON sf.zoneref = sc.zoneref
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON sc.arcref = sp.arcref AND sc.crewref = sp.crewref
    JOIN scanspatial ss ON sc.arcref = ss.arcref AND sc.crewref = ss.crewref
)
SELECT 
    zoneref,
    AVG(pcdr) as avg_density_ratio,
    AVG(fee) as avg_extraction_efficiency
FROM record_data
GROUP BY zoneref
ORDER BY zoneref
LIMIT 10;

-- Final query with proper column names matching user request
WITH record_data AS (
    SELECT 
        sf.zoneref,
        sp.totalpts::numeric / (sp.clouddense * ss.aream2) as pcdr,
        (sf.traitcount + sf.articount) * sqrt(sp.clouddense) / (sp.totalpts::numeric / (sp.clouddense * ss.aream2)) as fee
    FROM scanfeatures sf
    JOIN scans sc ON sf.zoneref = sc.zoneref
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON sc.arcref = sp.arcref AND sc.crewref = sp.crewref
    JOIN scanspatial ss ON sc.arcref = ss.arcref AND sc.crewref = ss.crewref
),
site_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        zoneref,
        AVG(pcdr) as avg_density_ratio,
        AVG(fee) as avg_extraction_efficiency
    FROM record_data
    GROUP BY zoneref
)
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    sm.avg_density_ratio AS avg_density_value,
    sm.avg_extraction_efficiency AS avg_extraction_value
FROM sites s
JOIN site_metrics sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
ORDER BY s.zoneregistry;

    SELECT sc.zoneref, AVG(sp.totalpts::numeric / (sp.clouddense * ss.aream2)) as avg_pcdr
    FROM scans sc
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON sc.arcref = sp.arcref AND sc.crewref = sp.crewref
    JOIN scanspatial ss ON sc.arcref = ss.arcref AND sc.crewref = ss.crewref
    GROUP BY sc.zoneref
),
site_fee AS (
    SELECT sf.zoneref, AVG((sf.traitcount + sf.articount) / (spc.avg_pcdr * sqrt(AVG(sp.clouddense))) * 1000) as avg_fee
    FROM scanfeatures sf
    JOIN scans sc ON sf.zoneref = sc.zoneref
    JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON sc.arcref = sp.arcref AND sc.crewref = sp.crewref
    JOIN site_pcdr spc ON sc.zoneref = spc.zoneref
    GROUP BY sf.zoneref
)
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    sp.avg_pcdr AS avg_density_value,
    sf.avg_fee AS avg_extraction_value
FROM sites s
LEFT JOIN site_pcdr sp ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref
LEFT JOIN site_fee sf ON s.zoneregistry = sf.zoneref
ORDER BY sf.avg_fee DESC NULLS LAST;
